chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from an-Nadr from 'Asim from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The people said to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him): 'Why do you not leave a man to pray in the two Eids?' He said, 'I do not go against the Sunnah.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.اَلْعِيدَيْنِ: The two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha)

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Ali not appoint a deputy to lead Eid prayers?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) commitment to maintaining the Prophetic Sunnah in public worship, specifically regarding the Eid prayers. His response, 'I do not deviate from the Sunnah,' underscores the Shia principle that the Imam’s actions serve as the definitive model for religious practice, ensuring continuity with the Prophet’s method rather than introducing administrative innovations. This reflects the broader theological stance that the Imam’s leadership is rooted in strict adherence to divine precedent.
